answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 59323 Country: India Title: Bookbinding task in Bank Question: I want to state that I am a business man. I have business of binding ex-book (school task copy and all types of copy maker). Can I take bank job for making like withdrawn slip, deposit slip, pass book etc. If I take directly from bank and if I take from third person in both the cases. It is lawful or not please explain according to Shariah. Answer ID: 59323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 792/778/N=09/1436) You may take passbook etc binding task from the bank directly or through someone else, it is allowable as it does not involve directly to interest dealing or helping in the same. It is lawful like the job of watchman or sweeper etc in bank. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
